newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services gets five-year contract.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services gets five-year contract.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said it has received a five-year contract from the state of Maryland, which could generate about $41 million over the life of the contract.
Under the contract, it will operate a 184-bed secure-care custody residential treatment program and a 16-bed transitional living unit known as Victor Cullen Academy.
Youth Services has been operating the facility since 1992, and the five-year contract is a renewal.
